notes: Defines the %countery macro (parses project-specific pre/post timestamp strings into SAS dates, keeping only participants with a valid, in-range post-survey date) and calls it once per RedCap project (14 calls), then runs one PROC FREQ per project on redcap_event_name and stacks all 14 results; kept byte-for-byte including every %countery() call and every PROC FREQ. Substituted one small mock <project>.redcap dataset per project (own scratch subdirectory per libname) shaped like a RedCap export, with ADHDApr's timestamps in YYYY-MM-DD (its branch parses with yymmdd10.) and every other project's in MM/DD/YYYY (the ELSE branch parses with mmddyy10.), matching what each project's real %countery() call expects.
